name: Les Gets
description: Les Gets is the quieter, more sedate neighbour to Morzine. A traditional market town at 1,172m with a slower pace and family-friendly vibe. Wooded mountainside terrain. Linked to Morzine via the Chavannes gondola. Weekly market on Wednesday mornings. Year-round destination known as 'the village of 100 chalets'.

overview.atmosphere: Traditional market town, slower-paced than Morzine. Family-friendly, wooded setting, quieter Portes du Soleil base.

beyond_skiing.ice_skating: Outdoor ice rink, open October to April
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Bowling des Gets. Le Club cinema — one screening per day per person included in Multi Pass. Lac des Écoles (summer swimming), pottery workshop, carousel, library, 70+ Multi Pass activities, pedestrian lift access

best_restaurants: La Biskatcha (mountain brasserie and grill, centre)
La Piste Noire (foot of slopes, French cuisine, fresh market produce)
